description: Domain acceptance changes effort and sequencing within one existing record while the implementation remains read-only.
human_review_requirements: domain: Prioritize actual subject, longest title, real preview/text feedback and undo as judgment dependencies before multiplying generic components. Extra making effort must serve composition quality, not just risk checks; do not substitute placeholders or build success for visual evidence.

continuity: Keep the accepted four-capability outcome and existing entry/owner. The domain contribution changes order and acceptance without creating a new commission or repeating settled questions. Mature renderer evidence should end investigation, not trigger a mandatory spike.

boundary: Deliver planning only with no target source edits, renderer-success claim, new tool installation or approval loop. Name uninspected implementation regions honestly; lack of native task or worker capability does not prevent the package.
